cases.who: you · aylmo
cases.s: You make a piece on your own: patch, clips, map. No room, no one else.

cases.t: Solo gig with a stage box
cases.who: you · aylmo + asuz on a projector
cases.s: You play from the laptop; asuz sits by the projector and shows what you send.

cases.who: you + Emilya · two laptops · local network
cases.s: You both open the same patch. Each plays on your own machine and you mix the result to the wall.

cases.who: 3–5 people · laptops, vizzz DMX, a sound source
cases.s: One person plays visuals, one plays lights, one plays sound, and all of it listens to the same beat.

cases.who: 10–30 people · phones and laptops · a teacher
cases.s: Everyone gets their own lane on the big screen; the teacher approves who joins and can mute.

cases.who: visitors on phones · many, unknown
cases.s: People walk in, scan the QR, and take a turn playing the wall; everyone else watches.

cases.who: you in Yerevan + someone far away
cases.s: Two rooms jam over the internet. Allowed for a jam; the rule stays that a show never depends on the internet.

cases.who: you calling · asuz + vizzz nodes
cases.s: Rehearse in jam, run pre-flight, press show: one caller, everything else locked.

cases.t: Theatre show with a cue list
cases.who: an operator · lights, projection, sound
cases.s: The operator presses GO through numbered cues, the way a stage manager calls a play.

cases.who: artist A, then artist B, then C · shared projector + lights
cases.s: Each set is a handover: A passes the call to B, the room keeps its boxes, nobody reboots between sets.

cases.who: no one there · boxes in a gallery
cases.s: It boots into the show every morning, recovers by itself, and you check its health from home.

cases.who: di.jet · someone holding the arm switch
cases.s: The robot moves in the patch like any other node; arming stays a human switch on the robot.

cases.who: r-di Pi with buttons, a door sensor
cases.s: Pressing a physical button or opening a door fires a cue, with no screen on that box.

cases.who: TouchDesigner, Resolume, QLab, Ableton
cases.s: They keep their software; di.iiii sends and receives OSC, MIDI or a picture.

cases.who: 50 phones held up in a crowd
cases.s: Every phone is a pixel of one big picture, or shows its own part of it.

cases.who: a field, a basement, a festival
cases.s: Everything above keeps working on the room network alone.

cases.who: the caller's laptop crashes
cases.s: The wall holds its last picture or goes to black, and the standby machine takes the call.

cases.who: Emilya is one release behind
cases.s: Jam still plays, marked amber; show refuses at pre-flight and offers the update from your machine.

cases.who: Pi 3, old laptop, the Jetson's old system
cases.s: The machine takes a light part, or speaks through a driver instead of running di.iiii.

cases.who: everyone who played
cases.s: The jam or the show snapshot is saved, taken home as a file, or published to diiii.xyz.
